localKey.label.purpose: Label of the owner's test switch that shows the app's own key estimates where rekordbox and file tags give none. It never changes with the state.
localKey.label.where: Settings screen, Optional features panel, the switch's label.

localKey.helpOff.purpose: Help under the switch while it is off: what turning it on shows.
localKey.helpOff.where: Settings screen, Optional features panel, under the local key switch while off.

localKey.helpOn.purpose: Help under the switch while it is on: which tracks show the estimate, and that turning it off hides them.
localKey.helpOn.where: Settings screen, Optional features panel, under the local key switch while on.

localKey.error.purpose: Shown when turning the local key switch on or off couldn't be saved. Same wording as the other switches.
localKey.error.where: Settings screen, under the local key switch.

localKey.compare.title.purpose: Caption of the table that counts how the app's key estimates agree with rekordbox's keys, overall and per genre.
localKey.compare.title.where: Settings screen, under the local key switch while it is on.

localKey.compare.empty.purpose: Shown instead of the table when no track has both a rekordbox key and a key estimate yet.
localKey.compare.empty.where: Settings screen, under the local key switch while it is on.

localKey.compare.loadError.purpose: Shown when the agreement counts couldn't be read. Same wording as the energy stars count error.
localKey.compare.loadError.where: Settings screen, under the local key switch while it is on.

localKey.compare.genre.purpose: Column heading: the genre node the row counts.
localKey.compare.genre.where: Settings screen, agreement table, first column heading.

localKey.compare.all.purpose: Row heading of the totals over every track with both keys.
localKey.compare.all.where: Settings screen, agreement table, first row.

localKey.compare.noGenre.purpose: Row heading for the tracks whose genre resolves to no genre node.
localKey.compare.noGenre.where: Settings screen, agreement table, last row.

localKey.compare.tracks.purpose: Column heading: how many tracks have both a rekordbox key and an estimate.
localKey.compare.tracks.where: Settings screen, agreement table, column heading.

localKey.compare.exact.purpose: Column heading: the estimate is rekordbox's key.
localKey.compare.exact.where: Settings screen, agreement table, column heading.

localKey.compare.relative.purpose: Column heading: the estimate is the relative key (same Camelot number, other letter), with an example.
localKey.compare.relative.where: Settings screen, agreement table, column heading.

localKey.compare.oneStep.purpose: Column heading: the estimate is one step round the Camelot wheel (same letter, next number), with an example.
localKey.compare.oneStep.where: Settings screen, agreement table, column heading.

localKey.compare.parallel.purpose: Column heading: the estimate is the parallel key (same tonic, other mode), with an example.
localKey.compare.parallel.where: Settings screen, agreement table, column heading.

localKey.compare.other.where: Settings screen, agreement table, column heading.

localKey.compare.cell.purpose: One cell of the agreement table: how many tracks, and their share of the row's tracks in whole percent.
localKey.compare.cell.where: Settings screen, agreement table, each count cell.
